Â Alertus Software Licensing and Support   Martinsburg VA Medical Center
Notice ID: 36C24527Q0081
Issuing office: Department of Veterans Affairs, Network Contracting Office 5
Response deadline: November  30, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time
Point of contact: Bernie Trotter;  bernadine.trotter@va.gov
Purpose
The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) is conducting market research to identify capable sources for software licensing and support of the existing Alertus emergency notification system at the Martinsburg VA Medical Center. VA seeks responses from the manufacturer and from distributors, resellers, and other service providers that can furnish the required licensing and support, directly or through a documented arrangement. VA welcomes responses from all capable sources, including SBA-certified service-disabled veteran-owned small businesses (SDVOSBs) and veteran-owned small businesses (VOSBs).
Anticipated requirement
VA anticipates a firm-fixed-price requirement with one 12-month base period and four 12-month option periods. The place of performance is the Martinsburg VA Medical Center, 510 Butler Avenue, Martinsburg, WV 25405. No hardware supplies are anticipated.
The anticipated scope includes:
Providing software licenses, updates, security patches, troubleshooting, diagnosis, configuration, and software repairs for the existing Alertus system.
Maintaining the installed software at the most current version approved under the VA Technical Reference Model (TRM) and applying patches in accordance with applicable federal and VA security requirements.
Accepting trouble calls 24 hours a day, seven days a week, and responding to and completing software repairs within 48 hours of receiving a trouble call, unless an alternate timeframe is coordinated with and accepted by the Contracting Officer s Representative under the resulting contract or order.
Maintaining Alertus as a device option within the existing AtHOC Mass Notification System and preserving emergency notification capability through existing text-to-voice beacons, speakers, and public-address interfaces.
Meeting applicable VA information security, privacy, and Section 508 accessibility requirements identified in the draft Statement of Work.


Information requested
Submit a concise capability statement addressing the following:
Company information. Provide your legal business name, Unique Entity Identifier (UEI), point of contact, email address, business size, and any applicable SBA certifications, including SDVOSB or VOSB status.
Licensing and authorization. Explain how your firm would furnish the required Alertus licenses, updates, and security patches. If relying on a manufacturer, distributor, or reseller arrangement, identify the arrangement and explain what it covers. If readily available, provide a current authorization letter or other documentation showing the scope of that arrangement.
Support and integration. Explain how your firm would provide 24/7 trouble-call intake, meet the 48-hour response and repair requirement, and maintain the existing AtHOC and public-address integrations. Identify which work your firm would perform directly, which work would be performed by Alertus or another partner, and any exceptions to the stated requirements.
Deployment and maintenance. State whether your firm supports VA-hosted deployments, vendor-hosted deployments, or both. Distinguish support for the Alertus application from maintenance of the host server and operating system. This notice does not request a hosting migration.
Contract vehicle and budgetary information. If the licenses and support are available under an existing federal contract vehicle, identify the vehicle, your contract number, and which items or services are currently available under it. If readily available, provide nonbinding budgetary pricing or the principal pricing assumptions for the base and option periods. A formal quotation is not requested.
Submission instructions and disclaimer
Email responses to Bernadine.trotter@va.gov  by November 30, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Use the Subject line:  36C24527Q0081   Alertus Licensing and Support RFI.  
Clearly mark any proprietary information and do not include patient information, credentials, or sensitive system details.
This notice is issued for market research and acquisition planning only. It is not a solicitation, a request for quotations or proposals, or a notice of intent to award sole source. Responses are not offers and cannot be accepted to form a binding contract. VA will not reimburse response preparation costs. This notice does not commit VA to issue a solicitation, use a particular contract vehicle, or make an award.Â Â
